origin: Ten machine-constructed invitation examples, authored before the proposed parser changes. These are not real invitations, human observations, a representative sample, or estimates of user accuracy/time saved.

cases.label: 도착 준비 기본
cases.text:
[행사 안내]

장소: 코엑스 오디토리움 3층
입장은 13:30부터 가능합니다.

cases.label: 정상 일정의 종료 시각 포함
cases.text:
정기총회 안내
장소: 코엑스 그랜드볼룸 1층
행사는 10:00에 시작하여 18:00에 종료됩니다.
cases.expectedRationale: The paired start/end times describe a schedule, not evidence that the event has already ended. Readiness means a reviewable route candidate only; explicit current-venue, height and safe-parking confirmation remains mandatory. Do not infer current occurrence from these times.

cases.label: 행사장과 등록층 분리
cases.text:
학술대회 안내
장소: 코엑스 아셈볼룸 2층
참가 등록은 1층 로비에서 진행합니다.
cases.expectedRationale: An explicitly labelled registration-only clause does not redefine the stated event venue. It must remain visible as a separate note; other facilities, cancellations, changes and unknown clauses must not be discarded.
